summary.para: Retrieves one or more Windows Known Folders.
Gets objects representing Windows Shell Known Folders. Results can be filtered by name, GUID, value, or by the built-in per-user, public, or all-folders parameter sets.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.GetKnownFolderCommand.Name
member.summary: Gets or sets the canonical name(s) of the Known Folder(s) to retrieve.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.GetKnownFolderCommand.FolderId
member.summary: Gets or sets the GUID(s) of the Known Folder(s) to retrieve.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.GetKnownFolderCommand.SpecialFolder
member.summary: Gets or sets the value(s) identifying the folder(s) to retrieve.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.GetKnownFolderCommand.All
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating that all registered Known Folders should be returned.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.GetKnownFolderCommand.Public
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating that only public (shared) Known Folders should be returned.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.GetKnownFolderCommand.PerUser
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating that only per-user Known Folders should be returned.

summary.para: Redirects (moves) a Windows Known Folder to a new path.

Calls the Shell Known Folder redirection API to change where a Known Folder is stored on disk. Supports moving a single folder by value or multiple folders from the pipeline, with optional data migration, read-only probing via -CheckOnly, and pass-through output.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.SingleFolder
member.summary: Gets or sets the Known Folder to redirect (single-folder parameter set).

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.NewPath
member.summary: Gets or sets the new absolute path for the folder (single-folder parameter set).

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.Folder
member.summary: Gets or sets the Known Folder piped from the pipeline (multiple-folders parameter set).

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.Destination
member.summary: Gets or sets the destination base directory; the folder's existing directory name is appended automatically (multiple-folders parameter set).

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.Force
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating that the ShouldContinue confirmation prompt should be suppressed.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.CheckOnly
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating that the redirection should only be validated without making changes.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.PassThru
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating that the redirected object should be emitted to the pipeline.

member.name: P:WozDev.PSKnownFolders.MoveKnownFolderCommand.DontMoveExistingData
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating that existing data in the source folder should not be moved to the new location.
